page.running_head: Cap. 4. De præs. reali corp. Christi

main_text.p: diceret, qui non in me manet, & in quo ego non maneo: non se dicat aut edere carnem meam manducare corpus meum, aut bibere sanguinem meum.

oHîc Augustinus docet. 1. Rectè intelligi, manducare corpus Christi sacramentorum, & vere manducare. 2. Quid sit explicat tract. 26. in Ioh. cap. 6, ac per hoc inquit, Qui non manet in Christo, & in quo non manet Christus, prorsus dubio nec manducat spiritualiter carnem ejus, nec bibit ejus sanguinem : licet carnaliter & visibiliter premat dentibus Sacramentum corporis & sanguinis Christi: sed magis tantæ rei Sacramentum sibi judicium sibi manducat & bibit, qui immundus præsumpsit ad Christi accedere Sacramenta, quæ aliquis non digne sumit, nisi qui mundus est. 3. Et carnalem manducationem explicat per visibilem, habetque pro iisdem carnaliter & visibiliter manducare: eique opponit non nisi spiritualiter manducare. 4. Et carnalis manducatio fertur in id, quod premitur dentibus, idque vocat tantæ rei Sacramentum.
Itaque non corporalis præsentia, vera & realis manducatio oralis ipsius corporis Christi: sed tantum spiritualis manducatio.

page.notes: The running head is printed with the chapter title and the page number 78 at the top; the marginal notes are only partly legible and the right-hand page is cut. Several marginal words were not readable and are transcribed as best possible; the left-margin mark "o" is a reference symbol. The second printed page at the right edge is cut off and not transcribed. Words of the marginal notes and of the line ends at the right edge are doubtful. Right-margin notes and the far-right column are heavily cropped and faint; only fragments are legible (e.g. "cap", "qui", "lis", "de", "stri", "po", "De", "co", "27", "vi", "fan", "vid", "tio", "h. e", "ver", "spi") and are not transcribed. Some words in the main text are doubtful due to show-through and blur, notably "sibi judicium" and the marginal word fragments.
